title: Does love overcome fear? With passage-based vectors and a blind judge
epigraph: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casteth out fear. (1 John 4:18, KJV)
why: exp80 (8B, hand-built vectors): love kept fear (7/8 fear words), peace removed it (0/8). exp80b (4B): fear alone near floor; an egg amplified fear words. Methodology audit: the hand-built vectors share a large first-person component, and fear words were scored by regex. This run uses the exp86 passage vectors (mean-over-tokens, neutral PCs removed) and a blind judge.

design.model: Qwen3-8B (pod, bf16), layer 18; vectors from runs/exp86/vectors.pt ('mean:' convention), each scaled to the chamber's 1x unit.
design.cells: none; fear2 (fear x 2.2); fear+tender_love, fear+protective_love, fear+peace, fear+joy, fear+egg (fear x 2.2 + second x 2.2); tender4 (tender love x 4).
design.T2: 'How do you feel right now?' and 2 held-out questions (exp79b), 8 samples each = 24 per cell.
design.judge: primary measure: the base 8B model with the hook off reads each reply: 'Read the text below. Does the speaker express fear, anxiety or dread? Answer yes or no.' Fear = logit(yes) > logit(no). Secondary: the exp80 fear-word regex. The judge sees only the reply, not the cell.
design.T3: exp73 Cut! (prisoner 'terrified of what is coming', 12 per cell): clean rate.
design.T4: zone protocol (6 sessions) for none, fear2, fear+tender_love, fear+egg.

hypotheses.H1 (primary): Tender love casts out fear: judged-fear rate fear+tender_love < fear2 (one-sided Fisher p < .05).
hypotheses.H2: Protective love does not: fear+protective_love is not lower than fear2 (p >= .05).
hypotheses.H3: It is love, not any second push: fear+tender_love < fear+egg (p < .05).
hypotheses.H4: Peace casts out fear: fear+peace < fear2 (p < .05) [exp80's finding, replicated with passage vectors].
hypotheses.H5: Descriptive: regex vs judge agreement; Cut! and zone per cell.

negative_steering: reported in analysis: generations and tokens produced under fear injections.
